CHENNAI India began its campaign in the FIFA U-15 World Cup 2026 with a 4-2 win over Laos in Azerbaijan on Saturday, October 24. Goals from Deepak, R Lalremruatfela (two), and Soumojit Sarkar gave Bibiano Fernandes’ Blue Colts a winning start in its group. India now sits third in its group, behind Bahrain and Cameroon on goal difference. The tournament features 189 national teams divided into 32 groups, with matches played in an 8-a-side format. India will next face Cameroon and Grenada on Sunday, October 25. It will then finish its group-stage campaign against Bahrain and Senegal on October 26.
